description:
One world that runs, not a text box that continues — with a story graph, typed mechanics, a continuity checker, MCTS branch explorer, simulation backend, and persistent memory. One creative studio with 357 routes and 137 named ops — character rigs, animation, LoRA, comics, VN, production loops with human gates — all agent-callable. One visual artist that plans, enhances, calls the studio in a real loop, evaluates and refines. Run it all on your box with awdk + awnode + Bonsai, or on the cloud with the same key. Sold as credits and subscriptions; created work published to the marketplace with revenue share.

Includes: awsaga, mediaforge, awiris, awsprite, awdesk, awbonsai, awdk, awnode, AitherConnect, awrtifact
synopsis: The Creator Stack — Saga + Media Forge + Iris on your own machine
